docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Rousseau's argument that legitimate authority rests on the general will of a free people.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712–1778), Du contrat social (1762), in the English translation of G. D. H. Cole (1889–1959), 1913. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
